faq.title: FAQ — Everything about XP, coins and games
faq.subtitle: The complete guide to the gamification system.
faq.whatQ: What is the XP and coin system?
faq.whatA: Every logged-in collector earns XP and coins: daily login (+10 XP, +50 coins), unlocking Twitch badges (+1,000 XP, +500 coins each), achievements (up to +5,000 XP) and games (+2 XP per round, +10 per win, capped at 100 XP per day). XP raises your level from 1 to 100; coins are the currency for games and heists.
faq.xpA: Daily login +10 XP plus +5 per streak day (max +50). Each synced Twitch badge +1,000 XP. Achievements pay 50 to 5,000 XP. Games pay +2 XP per round and +10 XP per win, capped at 100 XP per day to prevent farming. The Wheel of Fortune pays 25 to 2,500 XP per spin.
faq.levelsA: Level 1 starts at 0 XP. Each level needs 100 + (level-1) x 50 XP — level 100 totals 254,900 XP. Every level has a unique sparkle-animated level badge in your profile that is always visible and cannot be hidden.
faq.coinsQ: What do I do with coins?
faq.coinsA: Coins are bet in all 13 arcade games, paid as attempt costs for coin heists, and earned from daily bonuses, badge unlocks, achievements and game wins.
faq.dailyQ: How does the daily login bonus work?
faq.dailyA: Claim it once per day in the arcade hub or your inventory page: +10 XP and +50 coins. Consecutive days build a streak that adds up to +50 bonus XP and +250 bonus coins per day.
faq.wheelQ: How often can I spin the Wheel of Fortune?
faq.wheelA: Once per day. Prizes range from +25 XP (most common) to +2,500 XP (very rare), each with bonus coins.
faq.turboQ: Is the Twitch Turbo jackpot real?
faq.turboA: Yes — one wheel slot holds a free Twitch Turbo subscription with a win probability of exactly 0.00000001 (1 : 100,000,000), alongside 5,000 XP and 50,000 coins.
faq.badgesQ: Do my Twitch badges give XP?
faq.badgesA: Yes! Sync your badges after logging in — every newly unlocked badge pays +1,000 XP and +500 coins and appears in the live feed.
faq.gamesA: All luck-based outcomes (slots, roulette, wheel, coin flips, blackjack, scratch, tower) are rolled on the server and cannot be manipulated. Skill games (shooting, memory, catching) check scores server-side with caps.
faq.achievementsA: 125: 50 common milestones, 50 creative challenges and 25 truly unexpected specials. Each one awards XP, coins and points, plus a sparkle badge in your profile's achievement showcase.
faq.stealA: Open another collector's profile and attempt a heist. The victim sets the attempt price and maximum haul; the success chance (20 to 80 percent) shifts with the level difference between you two. Failed attempts pay the price to the victim.
faq.stealCostQ: Can I protect myself from thieves?
faq.stealCostA: In your settings you can disable stealing entirely, set the attempt price and cap the maximum haul. A flood check limits heists to one per victim per 5 minutes and 6 per hour.
faq.feedQ: What appears in the live feed?
faq.feedA: Every single XP gain: daily bonuses, badge unlocks, wheel spins, game rounds, achievements, level-ups, steals, coin rains and jackpot wins — from all collectors, updating every few seconds.
faq.profileA: 35 settings: 20 common (colors, fonts, banner, card style, frames, privacy toggles, social links) and 15 creative extras (aura, particle background, rainbow name, 3D tilt, pixel avatar, achievement ticker and more).
faq.visitorsA: Your profile shows the total view count plus the latest visitors as avatars. All view counters use a 5-minute per-IP reload block so refreshing does not inflate numbers.
faq.rainA: A coin rain is a small gift: any visitor can trigger one coin rain per day on your profile, giving you +1 coin with a little animation.
faq.blogQ: Where can I read more about features?
faq.blogA: Every game and feature gets its own detailed blog post with at least 300 words, view counts and emoji reactions. New drops and jackpot wins are announced there automatically.
faq.freeA: Yes — log in with Twitch, sync your badges and everything is playable for free. No purchases, no pay-to-win.
faq.dataQ: Where does my data come from?
faq.dataA: Badges sync from the official Twitch catalog; owner stats from potat.app; your owned badges resolve via badges.blog. Coins and XP are this site's own playful economy and have no monetary value.
